summary: Joseph told his brothers that what they meant for evil, God meant for good. Sabbath Camp looks back at Joseph's family and the whole Land of Promises.

story_reel.narration: Welcome to Sabbath Camp, and to the end of the Land of Promises! Joseph said to his brothers, 'You meant to hurt me, but God meant it for good, to save many people's lives.' Then Joseph comforted them and spoke kindly to them. He promised, 'I will take care of you and your little ones.' Joseph lived to be 110 years old. Before he died, he said, 'God will surely come to help you and bring you back to the land He promised to Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob.' Let's look back at this whole region! God called Abraham and promised to bless the whole world through his family. God provided a ram on the mountain. He gave Jacob a new name. And He was with Joseph from the pit to the palace. Through every twist and turn, every mistake and every sorrow, God kept His promises and worked everything for good. This region's biggest truth: you are chosen, provided for, given a new name, never alone, and forgiven. And you can forgive too.
